dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary macro-annuli exhibit a sharp gradient transition from a light-grey high-intensity outer perimeter to a low-intensity dark-grey interior core. The most central annulus is a closed 'O' shape with irregular scalloped edges, while the superior and posterior structures are roughly circular and exhibit a high-contrast boundary of approximately 8-12 pixels in width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters (blobs) is observed along the ventral-lateral margin. These lack an internal gradient and are distributed in a quasi-linear pattern trailing towards the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent isosceles triangular relationship is formed by the centroids of the two largest mid-body annuli and a distinct high-intensity blob located inferior-posterior to them. A secondary linear alignment is formed by four smaller annuli along the upper dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral flipper features a series of 5-7 distinct, deep vertical grooves along its posterior edge, creating a high-contrast serrated pixel topology.
